description: Every dense linear order without endpoints, interpreted in the strict-order language, is a model of the strict dense-order theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.model_strictDloTheory.{u} {M : Type u} [LinearOrder M]
  [DenselyOrdered M] [NoMinOrder M] [NoMaxOrder M] :
  have this := Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.binaryRelStructure M fun a b => a < b;
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.strictDloTheory
